question: How do all forms of knowledge and action ultimately return to Śiva?
premises: Even limited water on earth is drawn up by the sun and returns to the great ocean through rain.
All knowledge and action in the world arise in various ways.
Some arise by themselves and some through transmission by others.
inference: By analogy with the water cycle, all knowledge and action, whether direct or transmitted, ultimately merge in the ocean of Śiva.
plain_english: Even limited water on earth is drawn up by the sun's rays and returns again to the great ocean through rain; so too, all knowledge and action in the world, some arising by themselves and some through others in succession, sink into the ocean of Śiva.
